images.name: cover
images.title: The *AI office* manager
images.sub: Vendors, supplies, bills, calendars and new hires, and what still needs a person in the building.

images.name: duties
images.title: An office manager's week, *duty by duty*
rows: Logs requests, books the visit, follows up the same day if nobody shows.
Reorders below the reorder point, up to a set dollar limit. Checks what arrives.
Codes bills, leaves them at draft, flags renewals 60 days out.
Books rooms, fixes double bookings, flags clashing vacation requests.
Opens IT tickets, orders equipment, runs the exit checklist.
Collects three quotes side by side. A person decides.

images.name: handoffs
images.title: What it handles, and *what it hands off*
head: Area
The AI Employee handles
It hands to a person
rows: Small supply orders, bill coding, renewal reminders
Quotes, leases, anything over the limit
Letting people in, checking a leak
Onboarding checklists, office questions, time off
Sends the alert and the contact list
images.source: Examples. Every office sets its own limits.

images.name: wednesday
images.title: A Wednesday at a *15-person law firm*
rows: Answers two staff emails about holiday hours from the office handbook.
The HVAC tech didn't come Tuesday. It calls the company and rebooks for 1 pm.
Toner is below the reorder point. Places a $90 order with the supplier.
Three quotes for new boardroom chairs, side by side.
New paralegal starts Monday. Opens the IT ticket and orders the keycard.
A document tool renews in 60 days and nobody logged in since May.
A staff member sends a complaint about a coworker. Passed on untouched.

images.name: setup
images.title: How an AI office manager *is set up*
steps: Every weekly, monthly and yearly job, from copier service to holiday hours.
Who to call for what, and how each one likes to be contacted.
What it can order alone, and what waits for approval.
Inbox, calendar, accounting tool, supplier accounts. Payments stay at draft.
Money, the building, people issues and emergencies go to a named person.
It drafts every order and email while a person approves each one.
